title: AI-Powered Network Quality Prediction for Seamless Online Event Planning
summary: AI4Africa proposes forecasting connection quality to help plan online events. Avoided disruption and access benefits are not yet reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI4Africa proposes forecasting connection quality from a dataset to help plan online events. Implementation status is unspecified. Avoided disruption and access benefits are unreported.
purpose: Help organizers plan online activities around likely network conditions.

ratings.reason: Remote participants are intended to obtain more reliable online access.
Event organizers and institutions are intended to plan around poor connectivity; no actual event outcome is reported.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 10: AI-Powered Network Quality Prediction for Seamless Online Event Planning

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.

headline: Predicting network quality for online events
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
